# SQLite amalgamation

Vendored SQLite 3.50.4 amalgamation from <https://sqlite.org/2025/sqlite-amalgamation-3500400.zip>.
SQLite is in the public domain. See <https://sqlite.org/copyright.html>.

The CMake target enables FTS5 for the read-only ToolkitPs3 semantic graph browser,
disables run-time extension loading, and otherwise uses the serialized thread-safe
configuration.
